senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כהה) [to cause discoloring,] to sear, cauterize; to scald.
units: B. Kam. VIII, 1 כְּוָאוֹ בשפוד וכ׳ if a person hurt another with a hot spit &c.; Y. ib. 6ᵃ; 6ᵇ (Mish. a. Ib.) כְּוָייוֹ, כְּוָויוֹ; a. e.—Part. pass. כָּווּי burn-marked, flame-spotted.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 15">Lev. R. s. 15</cite> … <he>חמורה ונכוית ויצא בנה כ׳</he> a she-ass was sick and was cauterized, and her child was born with a flame-mark; (<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מרושם</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 7:4">Neg. VII, 4</cite> <he>וה׳ את המחיה</he> if one cauterized the cicatrizing spot.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="K00242">same</cite>. Num. R. l. c. <he>הוליכה … וכי׳ אותה</he> he took her to the veterinary surgeon, and he cauterized her.

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 75a:15">B. Bath. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>כל אחד וא׳ נִכְוָה חופתו מחופת וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) each man’s tent will be stained by fire from his neighbor’s tent. Lev. R. l. c. <he>נִכְוֵית</he>, v. supra. Num. R. l. c. <he>ממה שנִכְוֵת אמו</he> because his mother had been cauterized.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:6">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 6</cite> <he>היטה לכאן וניכ׳ בארו … ונכווה בשלג</he> if he deviates this way, he will be burnt by the fire, if that way, he will be frost-bitten; (<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 28:10">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXVIII</cite> <he>לוקה בצינה</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:6">Tosef. Ḥull. III, 6</cite> <he>יכולה לִיכָּווֹת וכ׳</he> she may be cauterized and recover.—Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ top <he>והיא נכוית</he> and it (the hand) is scalded (v. <cite ref="O00956"><he>סָלַד</he></cite>). Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ bot. <he>כמדומה … שאתם נִיכְוִין בפושרין וכ׳</he> I thought you would be scalded with tepid water (understand a slight hint), but you do not feel even hot water (distinct intimation); Bab.

<cite ref="Berakhot 16b">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite>.—Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ [read:] <he>רישיה דרישך יִכָּוֶה בפושרין ואתה לא תִיכָּוֶה אפי׳ ברותחין</he> thy head’s head (thy teacher’s teacher) feels tepid water, but thou &c., i.e. you must not claim superiority to your predecessors (cmp.
